data.title: 2.4 million girls banned from Afghan schools since Taliban return: UNESCO
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Around 2.4 million girls in Afghanistan have been denied access to secondary education since the Taliban returned to power in 2021, the United Nations said Tuesday, urging an end to such "discrimination".

data.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-term partner Georgina Rodriguez
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Cristiano Ronaldo and his long-time partner Georgina Rodriguez married on Tuesday in a ceremony in the Portuguese resort of Cascais, said the football superstar's representatives.

data.title: Tentoglou claims fourth Euro long jump title, injured Jacobs falters
data.description: BIRMINGHAM (UNITED KINGDOM) - Greece's Miltiadis Tentoglou soared out to a record-equalling fourth European long jump title in Birmingham on Tuesday, but Italian Marcell Jacobs was unable to claim a third 100m gold.

data.title: Thailand wary of Singapore threat

data.title: Cuba celebrates Castro's 100th as his revolution faces its toughest test
data.description: HAVANA - As Cuba marks 100 years since Fidel Castro's birth, Cubans are questioning the promises of the socialist revolution he led for nearly half a century, and asking whether his successors are up to the job.

data.title: Barred from elections, Russia's anti-war party vows to fight on

data.title: CSD submits exam fraud files to NACC

data.title: Court sets Nov 23 for Facebook lawsuits

data.title: Five-time MP Krieng dies at 74
data.description: Krieng Kalptinan, a former deputy interior minister and five-time MP for Ubon Ratchathani, died peacefully on Tuesday at Vichaiyut Hospital after battling cancer. He was 74.

data.title: Cabinet backs wider milk access

data.title: Cabinet approves 7-point school safety plan
data.description: <p>The cabinet on Tuesday approved seven urgent measures to strengthen safety at schools nationwide following last week's shooting at Debsirin Nonthaburi School, including screening for weapons, illegal items and drugs before anyone enters school premises.</p>
